topicName: How do you create and use functions in PL/SQL?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"How do you create and use functions in PL/SQL?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"PL/SQL functions are subprograms that perform a specific task and return a value.
